The '''Writhing Deep''' is the site of a [[silithid]] infestation in southeastern [[Feralas]]. It is a specific area for several quests in the zone. [[Raschal the Courier]] seem to somehow found his way down the hive.

It could also be considered to be Hive Zukk'ash, a minor silithid hive, considering the name of the silithid infesting the area.
